opportunities.title: Agriculture Land — Hyderabad, 10 Acres
opportunities.notes: Asking PKR 8M against an indicated PKR 10M. Canal share confirmed; mutation is clean but one boundary is disputed with the adjoining holder. Verify the survey before committing.

opportunities.title: Cold Storage Chamber — Khairpur
opportunities.notes: Owning the chamber rather than renting it would take roughly PKR 4.8M a year of storage cost out of the season. Compressors are 2019 and serviceable; the standby generator needs replacing.

opportunities.title: Agriculture Land — Hala Road, 20 Acres
opportunities.decisionNote: Negotiated to PKR 44M. Converted into AGL-014 and registered 25 Feb 2025.
opportunities.notes: Bypass extension was the thesis. Announced in June 2026, which has since held up.

opportunities.title: Six-Apartment Development — Gulshan-e-Iqbal
opportunities.decisionNote: Approved at a PKR 64M all-in budget. Converted into CON-005.
opportunities.notes: Plot plus construction against an expected finished value of PKR 86M. Contractor pre-qualified before approval.

opportunities.title: Commercial Shop — Auto Bhan Road
opportunities.decisionNote: Approved. Awaiting release of funds from the Bahria disposal before conversion.
opportunities.notes: Sitting tenant at PKR 95,000/month, which is a 7.9% yield on the asking price before any resale gain.

opportunities.title: Tractor Fleet Expansion — 2 Units
opportunities.notes: Existing fleet ran at 78% utilisation through the kharif season and we turned work away twice in July. Two more units would absorb it if the demand holds.

opportunities.title: Warehouse — SITE Area, Karachi
opportunities.decisionNote: Rejected. Yield of 9% before maintenance is below the rental portfolio it would join, and the roof needs PKR 6M of work the seller would not price in.
opportunities.notes: Worth revisiting only under PKR 50M, or if the roof is repaired before sale.

opportunities.title: Dairy Cluster Lending — Matiari
opportunities.notes: A dairy cluster with a functioning collection committee. Recovery in the existing book is 94%; a new geography without a track record should be sized smaller than that assumes.

opportunities.title: Residential Plot — Bahria Town Precinct 12
opportunities.decisionNote: Bought into PRT-021 at PKR 12.8M. Sold 18 Apr 2026 at PKR 16.9M.
opportunities.notes: Closed out ahead of the estimate and inside the horizon.
